title: Leading hypnosis questions about the Nine heard on tapes

tellings.quote: speculation. Like on the tapes, you can very much hear him saying, you know, is it is it the nine

related.note: Hypnosis tapes in which Puharich himself suggests the Nine. This tells the Nine coming through under hypnosis as Puharich's leading questions rather than real contact, which is a different core claim about the same kind of session.

plain: In the 1970s Andrija Puharich, a scientist who hypnotized people, recorded sessions in which a group called the Nine, said to be a council of non-human beings, seemed to speak through his subjects. According to the researcher Greg Malatzi, who has listened to those recordings, Puharich can be heard putting the idea forward himself, asking things like "is it the nine". Malatzi raises it because it would mean the messages may have been prompted by the hypnotist rather than coming from anywhere else.
